ledger: 00:00-00:09 Exterior establishing shot: rectangular diner building with wrap-around plate-glass windows, a front glass entrance door in the facade, booths visible on the left interior, and counter/kitchen on the right interior.

00:10-00:18 Interior shot looking toward the back kitchen pass-through: counter with red stools on the right, wood-paneled back wall with rectangular kitchen pass-through in the center, staff doorway behind the counter on the right wall, and a perpendicular wall/doorway opening immediately to the left of the pass-through.

00:19-00:26 Wide interior shot looking toward the back kitchen pass-through: the left side of the room now features a rear window with a neon 'OPEN' sign and a row of booths along a left window wall; the male customer enters by walking out from behind the counter near the staff doorway and kitchen pass-through, rounds the counter, and sits on a stool.

00:45-00:50 Reverse view from inside the kitchen looking out through the pass-through toward the front wall: counter is on the left, booths and windows on the right, and the far wall shows a solid white refrigerator and a glass entrance door with a glowing red 'EXIT' sign above it.

00:51-00:59 Closer interior shot looking toward the kitchen pass-through at sunrise: reverts to the 00:10 layout with the perpendicular doorway opening immediately left of the pass-through (and the seated customer missing from the counter).

01:00-01:26 Wide and medium shots looking toward the kitchen pass-through: waitress serves food from behind the counter, then walks around the back end of the counter past the pass-through to sit on a stool next to the customer.

01:27-01:34 Reverse angle looking toward the front wall opposite the kitchen: the glass entrance door, red 'EXIT' sign, and solid white refrigerator seen at 00:45 are replaced by a glass-front beverage cooler and a continuous plate-glass window.
01:41-01:49 Views through the left side windows above the booths: the male customer walks outside to a green-and-white truck parked parallel to the window wall while the waitress watches from inside.

01:50-01:58 Wide shot looking toward the kitchen pass-through: the waitress rises from the customer stool on the left side of the counter and walks directly through the solid counter into the staff area on the right while a second copy of her simultaneously appears at the kitchen pass-through in the background.

findings.entity: male customer and back-of-house area behind counter
findings.description: Upon arriving from outside, the male customer enters the dining room by walking out from the staff doorway and workspace behind the counter next to the kitchen pass-through (accompanied by the sound of the entrance door), rather than entering from the exterior entrance door at the opposite end of the room.

findings.entity: back wall to the left of the kitchen pass-through
findings.description: In the medium-wide shots at 00:10–00:18, 00:51–00:59, and 01:35–01:36, the wall immediately to the left of the kitchen pass-through terminates at a perpendicular wall with a side doorway/window opening and wood wainscoting. In the wide shots at 00:19–00:26, 00:36–00:44, 01:00–01:08, 01:18–01:26, and 01:50–01:58, that same space to the left of the pass-through is instead a wide rear window with a neon 'OPEN' sign and a line of booths.

findings.entity: front wall opposite the kitchen pass-through
findings.description: At 00:45–00:50, looking from the kitchen pass-through toward the opposite end of the diner shows a solid white refrigerator behind the counter and a glass entrance door with a red 'EXIT' sign above it at the end of the aisle. Looking in the same direction at 01:27–01:34, the entrance door, 'EXIT' sign, and white refrigerator are absent, replaced by a glass-door beverage cooler and an uninterrupted plate-glass window.

After standing up from the customer stool on the left side of the counter at 01:51, the waitress walks directly rightward through the solid dining counter to reach the workspace behind the counter at 01:53, while a duplicate of her simultaneously appears in the background at the kitchen pass-through.
